movie.title: Untitled Home Invasion Romance
movie.overview: As a last-ditch attempt to save his failing marriage, an actor stages a home invasion during a romantic getaway weekend.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Desperate to rescue his collapsing marriage, an actor stages a fake home invasion during a romantic getaway, only for his elaborate scheme to unravel into unexpected chaos.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: An actor facing the end of his marriage decides to take extreme measures to reignite the spark with his wife. He secretly plans a fake home invasion during a quiet, romantic weekend retreat, hoping to play the hero and win back her affection. However, his carefully orchestrated lie quickly spirals out of control, blurring the lines between staged drama and genuinely dangerous reality. As secrets unravel, the couple must navigate a chaotic web of romance, thrill, and dark humor to survive the night.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: Faced with an impending divorce, a struggling actor devises an outrageous plan to salvage his failing marriage. Believing a dramatic shared trauma will bring him and his wife closer together, he books an isolated cabin for a romantic weekend getaway. Behind her back, he hires accomplices and constructs a meticulous script for a staged home invasion where he can play the brave savior. When the fateful night arrives, the lines between performance and real life instantly begin to blur. Unexpected complications arise as the staged intruders go off-script, forcing the husband to improvise under intense pressure. Suspicions flare between the couple as the wife begins to realize that something about the situation is deeply wrong. As true dangers enter the mix, the evening devolves into a wild cocktail of high-stakes action, terrifying thrills, and absurd comedy. Ultimately, the couple is forced to confront not only the physical threats surrounding them, but also the raw, unvarnished truths about their broken relationship.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: Hoping to rekindle the dying flame of his marriage, a desperate actor arranges a secluded romantic getaway for his wife, complete with a secret, high-stakes twist: a staged home invasion designed to make him look like a hero. But when the fake attack meets unpredictable real-world chaos, the couple is thrust into a terrifying yet darkly comedic night of suspense, action, and relationship reckonings.

story_structure.climax: The situation escalates to a breaking point where artificial drama collides with genuine physical threat and emotional deception, forcing both partners into a life-or-death confrontation.
story_structure.conflict: Determined to play the protective hero, the husband secretly orchestrates a faux home invasion scenario, introducing a high-stakes artificial threat into their retreat.
story_structure.resolution: With the immediate crisis resolved, the couple must reckon with the fallout of the scheme and decide if authentic trust can ever be restored.
story_structure.introduction: An actor facing a collapsing marriage plans an isolated romantic getaway weekend with his wife, desperate to find a way to reignite their bond.
story_structure.risingAction: As the staged invasion unfolds, unforeseen variables emerge—complicating the plan, blurring the lines between performance and real danger, and testing the couple's underlying tensions.
